next_flight.countdown_target_note: No official SpaceX Flight 16 date. FAA planning materials cite NET 10 Dec 2026 (unconfirmed by SpaceX). Trade press also cites late Jan 2027 estimates. Launch site unconfirmed: Starbase Pad 2 or LC-39A (NASASpaceflight 19–20 Nov 2026, FCC filing context in secondary reporting).
next_flight.mission_notes: Expected_unofficial stack Booster 23 and Ship 43 for Flight 16 (Starlink). No official SpaceX date, pad, or vehicle assignment. FAA planning NET 10 Dec 2026; trade press late Jan 2027 estimates unconfirmed.

upcoming_flight_16.schedule_note: No official SpaceX date. FAA planning NET 10 Dec 2026; trade press late Jan 2027 (unconfirmed). Pad: Starbase Pad 2 or LC-39A unconfirmed. B-23/S-43 expected_unofficial for Starlink.

last_flight.catch_note: Ship catch time is T+22:32:34 on the SpaceX Flight 15 timeline, applied to the Wikipedia liftoff time of 22:47:36 UTC on 13 Nov 2026 (15 Nov 2026, 8:20 am AEDT / 14 Nov 3:20 pm CST / 4:20 pm EST). The official SpaceX catch post was published at 21:21:41 UTC.
last_flight.phase_note: Ship 42 was caught at the Pad 2 tower. Booster 22 aborted its catch and diverted offshore. Payload: all 26 Starlink V3 satellites deployed.
last_flight.mission_notes: First catch of a Starship upper stage (Ship 42) by the Mechazilla arms. Super Heavy booster 22 aborted the tower catch after an early boostback shutdown (low fuel mass; root cause under investigation), diverted to an offshore landing, hovered over the Gulf, and the flight termination system was triggered at landing-burn shutdown.
